auditConfiguration.scope: All nodes on all four pages, plus targeted master-to-instance verification for both new variants.

unboundPaints.details: All four pages were walked. Existing unbound paints were enumerated (Cover 1, Templates 33, Screens 34, Archive 10). The only new unbound paints are the established organizer fill/stroke on sections 518:5771 and 521:7834; the product component, comparison helpers, and their descendants introduce no unbound solid paints.

fractionalAuthoredGeometry.details: No fractional authored geometry was found on any page or in either new subtree. Intrinsic VECTOR and GROUP bounds were excluded per standing rule 8.

referenceCounts.details: Comment=Empty and Comment=Filled each contain two componentPropertyReferences: the row Condition text reference and the published Icon button's inherited Icon reference. Counts match across variants.

componentIdentity.details: Proof instances resolve to Checkbox 155:1492, Icon button default/medium 77:1105 within the published Icon button set, ChatOutlined key 6bc407c23e71eb80b9334cde47be426cba738941, and ChatFilled key d6feeb4017e9bebc5e3bf526f88c8b2e376be6c5. The sole comparison remains an instance of shared master 35:332.

propertyReferences.details: Trauma renders from Condition=Trauma with Comment=Empty; Cataracts renders from Condition=Cataracts with Comment=Filled. Rendered text and nested icon main-component keys match their instance properties.

instancePaintVerification.details: Four rendered solid paints were compared for each master/proof pair. Empty and Filled each returned zero colour, effective-alpha, or bound-variable mismatches.

observations: The source and rebuild preserve the same visible checkbox, label, and outlined comment-glyph relationship.
The rebuild's 42px row keeps the published Checkbox and Icon button touch targets without enlarging their visible glyphs.
The filled Cataracts proof uses the published ChatFilled icon and remains aligned with the empty Trauma state.
The compact comparison uses an instance-level clip override; the shared comparison master is unchanged.

toolCalls.note: Counts include dependency discovery and atomic failed writes. Failed Figma scripts rolled back without leaving target nodes.
